# Remove-ZbxHostTemplate

## SYNOPSIS

Unlinks templates from hosts.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxHostTemplate [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-Template] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Remove-ZbxHostTemplate cmdlet unlinks the template in -Template from the hosts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped hosts) with host.massremove, in one call when the pipeline ends. The items, triggers and graphs the template brought stay on each host as the host's own, no longer linked. The command asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and writes the hosts only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Unlink a template from a host

```powershell
Remove-ZbxHostTemplate -InputObject 'web-01' -Template 'Web App' -Confirm:$false
```

ConfirmImpact is High; -Confirm:$false skips the prompt.

### Example 2: Unlink a template from the hosts a search finds

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'db-*' | Remove-ZbxHostTemplate -Template 'Web App' -WhatIf
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'db-*' | Remove-ZbxHostTemplate -Template 'Web App' -Confirm:$false
```

-WhatIf first shows each host the command would change; the second call changes them.
